etym.s: [cf. Gk. ἐπί; Zend api; Germ. and Eng. prefix be]

spans.s: in later Sanskṛt its place seems frequently supplied by अभि.
(As a separable adv.) and, also, moreover, besides, assuredly, surely
suppose that, perhaps, Jātakam.
अपि or अपि-च, as well as
वापि or न अपिवा or न नचापि, neither, nor, चापि, (and at the beginning of a sentence) अपि-च, moreover.
is often used to express emphasis, in the sense of even, also, very
e.g. अन्यद् अपि, also another, something more
अद्यापि, this very day, even now
तथापि, even thus, notwithstanding
अपि, even if, although
तथापि, although, nevertheless
कदाचिद् अपि, never at any time: sometimes in the sense of but, only, at least, e.g. मुहूर्तम् अपि, only a moment.
may be affixed to an interrogative to make it indefinite, e.g. को ऽपि, any one
कुत्रापि, anywhere.
imparts to numerals the notion of totality, e.g. चतुर्णाम् अपि वर्णानाम्, of all the four castes.
may be interrogative at the beginning of a sentence.
may strengthen the original force of the Potential, or may soften the Imperative, like the English ‘be pleased to’;
sometimes it is a mere expletive.
तु but, but yet.
(अपि-अपि), as well-as, ib.
